method: Independent institutional bibliographic witnesses identifying works, continuation authors and scholarly collected editions. These confirm edition-level facts, not individual ICRSP hosted paragraph provenance or republication rights.

confirmedWitness.institution: Abbaye Saint-Pierre de Solesmes / Éditions de Solesmes
confirmedWitness.fact: Guéranger published nine volumes between 1841 and 1866 and left L'Année liturgique unfinished at his death in 1875. His written work concludes on the eve of Trinity Sunday; Dom Lucien Fromage completed the Time after Pentecost in further volumes.

works.candidatePrintedWitness: Guéranger's original volumes (1841–1866), and the post-Trinity continuation attributed to Lucien Fromage. Precise edition, volume, page, and normalized paragraph must be checked independently.
works.action: Do not infer Guéranger authorship from website label for all post-Trinity commentary. Partition by original dated volume and paragraph collation before attribution.

confirmedWitness.institution: Bibliothèque nationale de France, catalogue général
confirmedWitness.fact: The Annecy Visitation-edited Œuvres de saint François de Sales is a scholarly collection issued 1892–1964 in 27 volumes; Sermons appear in volumes VII–X, with named scientific editors.

additionalWitness.fact: The Abbey's present publication identifies sermons as vols VII-X, with separate correspondence and opuscula volumes.

works.candidatePrintedWitness: Annecy collected edition, Volumes VII–X (Sermons): match actual sermon date, text incipit, pages, whether sermon is full autograph/dictation, edited précis or plan.
works.action: Do not equate a dated host panel, an editor's outline or a sermon plan with a complete attested sermon in the saint's words. Modern edition and translation rights remain unreviewed.
